reviews.title: Daily tutoring app usage improves mathematics scores

findings.message: The manuscript uses causal language, but the stated design does not independently support causal inference.

evidence.claim: Daily tutoring app usage improves mathematics scores.

findings.remediation: Replace causal verbs with associational language or add a causal identification strategy with assumptions and diagnostics.

findings.message: Causal review requires a comparator, control, counterfactual, or explicit quasi-experimental contrast.
findings.remediation: Add a comparator/control description and explain why it approximates the counterfactual.

findings.message: The evidence packet does not show that exposure or intervention preceded the outcome.
findings.remediation: Document timing of exposure, intervention, measurement, and outcome windows.

findings.message: No confounder strategy is described for a causal claim.
findings.remediation: Describe randomization, matching, adjustment, stratification, sensitivity analysis, or a defensible natural experiment.

findings.message: The packet reports an effect size without an uncertainty interval.
findings.remediation: Add confidence, credible, or bootstrap intervals and specify the estimation method.

reviews.reviewerNote: education: HOLD before release because the manuscript uses causal language, but the stated design does not independently support causal inference.
